data.body_html:
Starlite 2041 is Marbella’s defining summer festival, held at the spectacular Cantera de Nagüeles amphitheatre. While the concert itself is the headline, the evening can start earlier — aboard a private boat cruising from Puerto Banus along the Costa del Sol. This guide covers everything you need to know to combine a pre-concert boat charter with your Starlite 2041 experience, from boat options and pricing to logistics and timing.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Makes Sense

A Starlite 2041 pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banus isn’t just transport; it’s the opening act. You leave the dock at sunset, the Sierra Blanca turning pink behind La Concha, the sea glassy and warm. Drinks are poured, snacks are passed, and the chatter builds anticipation. By the time you step ashore and take the short taxi to the quarry, you’re already in festival mode — without the stress of traffic or queuing.

Boats Available for Your Starlite Evening

Our fleet covers groups from two to twelve people. All depart from Puerto Banus. For a Starlite pre-concert cruise, we recommend:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h. Modern, sleek, perfect for couples or a small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h. Similar size, slightly higher capacity.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski. For a VIP blowout.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp.
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, VAT, and a selection of drinks and snacks. No hidden costs.

Suggested Itinerary: Sunset Sail + Starlite

18:00 – Board at Puerto Banus. Cast off and head east towards Marbella’s coastline.
18:15–19:45 – Cruise past the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and the Marbella Marina. Anchor briefly for a swim if the group wants.
19:45 – Return to Puerto Banus. Disembark.
20:00–20:15 – Taxi to the Cantera de Nagüeles (approx. 15 min).
20:30 – Arrive at Starlite, grab a drink, find your seats.
21:00 – Concert begins.

This schedule works for a 2-hour charter. If you want more time on the water, book a 4-hour charter and depart earlier.

Logistics: Getting from Puerto Banus to Starlite

The festival site is inland, about 8 km from Puerto Banus. A taxi costs €20–30 and takes 15–20 minutes. Uber and Cabify operate in Marbella, but availability after the concert can be tight — pre-book a return taxi or arrange with a local driver. Alternatively, if you’re staying near the Golden Mile, the taxi from Puerto Banus is quick. For those staying in central Marbella, the taxi from the marina is under 15 minutes.

What to Wear and Bring

Evenings on the water can be cooler than expected. Bring a light jacket or sweater. For the boat, non-slip shoes or barefoot is fine. For Starlite, dress code is smart-casual to cocktail. Don’t forget sunscreen for the sunset sail — the sun is still strong at 18:00 in July. Your skipper will have a cooler with drinks, but feel free to bring a bottle of wine (no glass on board).

Booking Your Starlite Pre-Concert Cruise

Availability for Starlite dates fills quickly, especially for Tier A boats. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you can book directly online at our Boat Rental Marbella page. For larger vessels like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 or Ferretti 94, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance for summer concerts.

Frequently Asked Questions

How far is Starlite from Puerto Banus?

The festival site is about 8 km inland from Puerto Banus, near the Nagüeles quarry. A taxi takes 15–20 minutes and costs roughly €20–30. Pre-booking a taxi is recommended, especially after the concert.

Can I sail directly to Starlite?

No. Starlite is held at an inland quarry, not on the coast. The boat cruise is the prelude: you sail along the Marbella coastline, enjoy sunset views, then dock at Puerto Banus and take a short taxi to the venue.

What time should we start the cruise?

For a 21:00 concert, depart Puerto Banus at 18:00 or 18:30. That gives you 1.5–2 hours on the water for a sunset sail, plus 30 minutes to taxi and arrive at Starlite by 20:30.

What’s included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish VAT (21%), soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No hidden extras.

Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?

The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h) are ideal for couples or small groups. Larger groups (up to 12 pax) can opt for the Mangusta 80 (24m, from €4,719/4h) which includes a free jet ski.

Can we bring our own food or drinks?

Our charters already include drinks and snacks. You may bring extra food, but glass bottles are not allowed for safety. Check with us beforehand if you have special requests.

How do I book?

Contact us via WhatsApp (link on our site) to check availability and receive a personalised quote. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. Payment is via bank transfer or card.

What happens if the weather is bad?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll offer a full refund or reschedule. Generally, Marbella summers are calm, with sea breezes typical in the evening.
